purpose: Teach: アテネ/アーキテクチャ/メーリングリスト/ファイナンス/エステ/ゲリラ/アイヌ/名乗る

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアテネの遺跡の本を読んでらしたぞ
lines.en: You know, Gran — when your father was young, he was always reading about the ruins of Athens.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Gentle opening, as if turning a page. Quiet, measured pace. Slight pause before the detail, like reaching back through decades. Warm but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、家のアーキテクチャにこだわられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father was always so particular about the way things were built, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly teasing. Her voice settling into a shared memory. Warm murmur on the endearment. Speaking to him as they've spoken for sixty years — checking in, affirming what they both know.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、メーリングリストって新しい言葉、お父さんも興味を持たれたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, your father became fascinated by this new word, 'mailing list.'
lines.style: Same gentle reaching-back quality. A small smile in the voice at the oddness of the detail. Slower on 'mailing list,' like he's remembering the exact novelty of it. Fading softly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お家のファイナンスをきちんと管理されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he was always so careful about managing the household accounts properly, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Light, knowing warmth. The word 'carefully' carries a hint of dry affection — she's teasing him gently about how seriously he took these things. Familiar territory. The 'dear' lands with decades of intimacy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、ばあさんがエステに通っていたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when you were young, you used to go to the beauty salon so regularly.
lines.style: Gentler this time, almost tender. A slight lift of admiration in his voice. He's not just remembering — he's honoring something about her. Slower pace, like he's seeing her young again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ゲリラ雨でずぶ濡れになったお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you were telling him about that time you got completely soaked in that sudden downpour, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright, almost laughing with the memory. She's vivid and present — this is a story she loves telling. Quick, energetic delivery on the setup. The 'dear' is warm teasing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアイヌ文化の本を読まれたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when he was young, your father was reading deeply about Ainu culture.
lines.style: Reverent and careful. Slower pace — this one matters more. He's honoring something about his son's curiosity and dignity. Breath held slightly, like the respect he carries. Quiet close.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご自身の名前を名乗るときも丁寧でしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And even when he introduced himself, he was always so polite and formal about it, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft, deeply affectionate. Almost a whisper of pride. She's speaking about a gentleness in him she loved. The 'dear' is intimate, private — just for him. Trails off gently at the close, as if the memory itself is tender.
